entries.description: Located RDF definitions at src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web/Reports/orders-by-customer.rdf.json and sales-by-product.rdf.json. Both RDFs already define a ReportHeader band containing StaticText 'Orders by Retail Business' / 'Sales by Product' (styleName reportTitle, 18pt bold) plus FilterSummary + dateStamp + thickLine. Both also define a PageHeader band containing StaticText column-header labels (Order #, Order Date, Ship Date, etc.) with an underline. Title is NOT missing from the RDFs — they are structurally correct.

Inspected DabblerReportPage.ExportToPdfAsync (src/Libs/Dabbler.Reports.Blazor/DabblerReportPage.razor.cs:225-249) and PdfExporter.ExportAsync (src/Libs/Dabbler.Reports.Export/PdfExporter.cs:50-89). Exporter consumes a pre-composed IReadOnlyList<PageLayout> and iterates each page, delegating to PdfPageRenderer.RenderPage. PdfPageRenderer renders every element in page.Elements (src/Libs/Dabbler.Reports.Export/PdfPageRenderer.cs:60-65) without filtering by band type. PdfExporter.Title is declared but never written to PDF metadata — it sets a local property only. PdfPageRenderer contains no hard-coded title draw. Conclusion: the renderer renders exactly what the composer produces; the bug is not in the renderer.

Traced BandLayoutEngine.PageComposer (src/Libs/Dabbler.Reports.Core/Layout/BandLayoutEngine.cs). On Compose for a data report (ComposeDataReport, line 310), StartNewPage() is called FIRST (line 312), and StartNewPage emits the PageHeader band at _yCursor=_marginTop (line 1350-1351). ONLY AFTER that does the method emit the ReportHeader band via EmitBandWithPageBreakCheck (line 315-316). Net effect on page 1: PageHeader (column headers) renders at y=0.5in, then ReportHeader (title) renders at y=0.9in BELOW them. The title IS present on page 1 but appears underneath the column headers — which is why the reviewer said 'the title doesn't print'; they see column headers at the top of the page and read the title as missing from its expected location. The XML doc comment (line 19-22) confirms this inverted order ('Page 1: PageHeader -> ReportHeader'), which is non-conventional: Jasper-style band engines place the title (ReportHeader) ABOVE the PageHeader on page 1. No existing unit tests cover composer band ordering (no Dabbler.Reports.Core.Tests project exists).

Target behavior: Path a (preferred per spec). On page 1, emit ReportHeader BEFORE PageHeader; on subsequent pages, emit PageHeader at the top as today. The RDF definitions already contain the title in ReportHeader bands and the column headers in PageHeader bands — no RDF edits needed. Session 2 will change BandLayoutEngine.cs so the composer emits ReportHeader before the first page's PageHeader (either by having ComposeDataReport emit ReportHeader, then call a helper to emit PageHeader, and refactoring StartNewPage to skip PageHeader on the first call; or equivalent), update the XML doc comment on lines 19-22, add a unit test asserting element Y order on page 1 and page 2 for a report with both ReportHeader and PageHeader, and add a PDF-bytes regression test that extracts text from the exported PDF and asserts the title string appears on page 1 with column headers appearing on every page. Files to touch in Session 2: src/Libs/Dabbler.Reports.Core/Layout/BandLayoutEngine.cs, and a new test project or file under tests/Dabbler.Reports.Core.Tests (or add tests to an existing export-focused project). Risk: changing the composer affects every report, not just the two UAT-flagged ones. Mitigated because (a) the current order is non-conventional, (b) no tests assert the old order, (c) both reports in the app use the fix correctly as-is once the order is inverted.

Ran 'dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln' -> Build succeeded, 0 warnings, 0 errors, 6.71s. Ran 'dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln --no-build --filter "FullyQualifiedName!~Playwright"'. Results: Dabbler.Reports.Blazor.Tests 8/8 pass, Dabbler.Components.Tests 33/33 pass, Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests 120/120 pass, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests 12/12 pass, Dabbler.Security.Tests 261/261 pass, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests 118/119 (1 failure). The single failure is WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates which asserts docs/workflow-auth-observability.md exists; that doc was intentionally deleted by commit 8730107 ('Repository cleanup and packaging-and-template-readiness spec update') as part of planning-doc cleanup. This failure is PRE-EXISTING and unrelated to Session 1 (diagnostic only, no code changes were made). It should be tracked separately; Session 1 did not introduce it and Session 2 should not be expected to fix it.
